answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 38447 Country: India Title: If a person passes an examination Question: If a person passes an examination by cheating (e.g. copying or any other improper means) and gets a degree and with that degree he gets a job and earns his living. Whether in this condition his earnings from that source is halal or haram? Answer ID: 38447 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 802/668/B=1433) Yes, his income is halal provided he does his assigned job well and fulfils his duty. He gets the salary of his work; hence that salary is lawful and halal without any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
